messages:
oncall-rota: handing off to @alex for the overnight shift. ongoing incident: auth failures in eu-west-1 affecting streaming sessions for a subset of dedicated customers. pager triage in progress. primary: alex, secondary: maria. please read below for current mitigations and things to watch. :wave:
oncall-rota: inc id INC-2026-99 (internal) — several 502/401 spikes starting ~02:15 UTC, error rate ~8% for dedicated pools in eu-west-1, overall hosted traffic OK. customer-impact: a few customers on dedicated pools report dropped streams and auth errors.
incident-bot: ALERT: auth-proxy-eu1 (podset) health check flapping x5 in 5m — threshold breached. Ticket: INC-2026-99.
alex: got it. quick summary from last 30m: cert rotation was pushed at 01:52 UTC to the auth CA bundle. some auth-proxy replicas didn't pick up new certs and started returning 401 on long-lived token introspections. autoscaler restarted a few pods which created short windows of 502 while KV tokenstore timed out.
maria: adding runbook refs: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/auth-cert-rotation — follow section "rollback certs" then "soft-fail token-introspect". also see playbook: /runbooks/streaming-fallbacks (internal).
sam: logs from proxy show repeated TLS handshake errors and failing OCSP responses. snippet: ```[2026-05-14T01:53:10Z] auth-proxy[grpc] ERR tls: handshake failure: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority```
jess: quick mitigations we already applied: 1) increased token cache TTL from 30s -> 300s for affected pools (config pushed to feature-flags, rollout 01:58) 2) temporarily widened auth-proxy liveness probe timeout to avoid churn 3) forced restart of 3 auth-proxy sts pods that hadn't loaded the CA.
alex: current state: error rate down from 8% -> 2.1% after restarts and cache change. still seeing occasional 401s for streams >5m. active mitigations: continuing pod restarts (rolling), verifying CA bundle on each node, and we have a fallback policy to route long-lived streams to eu-central if failure persists.
ops-bot: ROUTING CHANGE: applied routing policy eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 for stream_fallback group. Effective 02:05 UTC.
maria: note: fallback increases latency ~80-120ms for affected customers; communicate to support if they call. Also watch tokenstore queue length metric tokenstore.request_queue_size — it's trending up. if > 1200, we'll need to scale tokenstore to avoid timeouts.
sam: command to check problematic pods: ```kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=auth-proxy,region=eu-west-1 -o wide``` and to inspect certs: ```kubectl exec -it <pod> -n infra -- openssl s_client -connect token-introspect.internal:443 -showcerts```
alex: escalation note: if error rate goes >5% again or tokenstore queue >1500, page infra-leads and bring in security for cert validation. currently paging thresholds left at defaults.
jess: handoff checklist for next oncall: - primary = alex (you) - secondary = maria - bookmarks: runbook link above, grafana dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/auth-proxy-eu1 - quick commands in cribsheet: /confluence/ops/cribs/auth-proxy-commands - contact SME: @kevin (pkg: auth), @hana (network).
oncall-rota: reminder: update the incident channel when you make a routing change or escalate. add a short note on customer outreach if support starts receiving tickets.
alex: will monitor for the next 2h, starting watch cycle now. I'll post a status update in 30m or on any major change. leaving this thread for handover notes.
maria: acknowledged, will remain secondary and stand by for escalation. will check tokenstore scaling tonight at 03:30 UTC.
incident-bot: NOTE: Incident INC-2026-99 status = investigating. Severity = P2.
alex: added a short checklist log in the incident ticket: "restarted stuck auth-proxy pods; increased token cache TTL; applied routing fallback to eu-central; watching tokenstore queue".
jess: thanks team, leave any follow-ups here. I'll update the handoff doc when primary changes. :white_check_mark:
